title: Web: Setup, Activity values
description: GET /api/coach/setup/activity. The calibration values. POST /api/coach/setup/activity {values: {key: number}} turns the changed values into one calibration_change proposal (chat's propose_change): its card goes to Telegram and nothing changes until it is approved there. Returns {proposal: {id, new_values, created_at, change, referenced}, section: this view}; a value out of range is refused (400) with the guardrail's reason.

editable.description: A phase is active and no phase setup is open.

run_kcal_discount.description: Share of a run's kcal counted (0..1].

pending.description: Open calibration proposals waiting for a tap in Telegram.
